age_minimum.quote: stating therein that he is more than 21 years of age

degree_required.quote: shall have received a diploma conferring upon him the degree of doctor of optometry or what in the opinion of the board may be considered the equivalent thereof

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved school or college of optometry
accrediting_body.quote: has been graduated from a school or college of optometry maintaining a standard satisfactory to the board and which was in good standing in the opinion of the board at the date of graduation

exams.name: Board Examination (New Jersey State Board of Optometrists)
exams.notes: Applicant must take an examination before the board to determine qualifications; if satisfactory to majority of board, receives certificate of registration
exams.jurisdiction: state (New Jersey State Board of Optometrists)
exams.quote: shall have taken an examination before the board to determine his qualifications therefor. If the examination of any applicant for registration shall be satisfactory to the majority of the board, he shall receive from it a certificate of registration authorizing him to practice optometry.

exams.name: International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry examination
exams.notes: Passing this exam may be used as a basis for licensure without further examination (reciprocity pathway)
exams.jurisdiction: national (International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry)
exams.quote: upon proof that he has successfully passed an examination conducted by the International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry

interval_years.quote: all professional or occupational licenses or certificates of registration...shall, on and after the effective date of this act, be issued for periods of two years and be biennially renewable

required.quote: All registered active optometrists now or hereafter licensed in the State of New Jersey shall be required to take courses of study relating to the practice of the profession of optometry

hours_per_period.quote: Fifty credits of continuing professional optometric education shall be required biennially of each New Jersey optometrist holding an active license

period_years.quote: Fifty credits of continuing professional optometric education shall be required biennially

value: at least one credit for educational programs or topics concerning prescription of hydrocodone, or prescription of opioid drugs in general, including responsible prescribing practices, alternatives to opioids for pain management, and risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion
topical_requirements.quote: at least one credit shall be for educational programs or topics that concern the prescription of hydrocodone, or the prescription of opioid drugs in general, including responsible prescribing practices, the alternatives to the use of opioids for the management and treatment of pain, and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion.

available.quote: may, in the discretion of the board, be granted a license to practice optometry without further examination upon the payment to the treasurer of the board of a license fee of fifty dollars ($50.00)

requirements.value: Applicant must prove good moral character, U.S. citizenship or declared intent, licensure by another state's board with substantially equal standards, or passage of the International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry exam; must file a verified copy of the other state's license.
requirements.quote: Any applicant for license to practice optometry, upon proving to the satisfaction of the board that he is of good moral character, a citizen of the United States, or has declared his intention to become such a citizen, and that he has been examined and licensed by the examining and licensing board of another State of the United States, and that at the time of the granting of such license the standard of requirements for the license to practice optometry in the State where such license was granted was at least substantially equal to the standard of requirements for such license established by this chapter

exists.quote: The New Jersey State Board of Optometrists shall establish a comprehensive credentialing and certification process for optometrists

credential_type.quote: he shall receive from it a certificate of registration authorizing him to practice optometry

is_mandatory.quote: No person, not a holder of a certificate of registration duly issued to him, shall practice optometry within the State

title_protection.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of this chapter who in any way advertises himself as an optometrist

scope_protection.quote: No person, not a holder of a certificate of registration duly issued to him, shall practice optometry within the State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained a certificate, registration, license, or authorization to sit for an examination through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence that damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as determined by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense with a direct or substantial relationship to the regulated activity or inconsistent with public health, safety, or welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board or is of a nature such that certification, registration or licensure of the person would be inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had authority to engage in the regulated activity revoked or suspended by any other state, agency, or authority for reasons consistent with this section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provision of insurance fraud prevention law or was adjudicated of such a violation in civil or administrative proceedings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of P.L.1983, c.320 (C.17:33A-1 et seq.) or any insurance fraud prevention law or act of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use likely to impair the ability to practice the profession with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or knowing the substances were to be used for unauthorized consumption or distribution
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or where the applicant or holder knew or should have known that the substances were to be used for unauthorized consumption or distribution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform a licensed act, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

definition_quote.value: the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae for the purposes of ascertaining any departure from the normal, measuring its powers of vision and adapting lenses or prisms for the aid thereof, or the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction, and excluding controlled dangerous substances as provided in sections 5 and 6 of P.L.1970, c.226, except as otherwise authorized by section 9 of P.L.1991, c.385, for the purposes of treating deficiencies, deformities, diseases, or abnormalities of the human eye and adnexae, including the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexae
definition_quote.quote: the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae for the purposes of ascertaining any departure from the normal, measuring its powers of vision and adapting lenses or prisms for the aid thereof, or the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction

value: objective examination of the human eye and adnexae
subjective examination of the human eye and adnexae
use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents (excluding injections except for anaphylaxis)
removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexae
administration of immunizations against coronaviruses and influenza
methods_authorized.quote: the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae for the purposes of ascertaining any departure from the normal, measuring its powers of vision and adapting lenses or prisms for the aid thereof, or the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may use and prescribe pharmaceutical agents for treating deficiencies, deformities, diseases, or abnormalities of the human eye and adnexae, including Schedule III, IV, and V controlled dangerous substances and pharmaceutical agents containing hydrocodone, but excluding injections (except for anaphylaxis) and Schedules I and II controlled dangerous substances (except hydrocodone). Oral pharmaceutical agents require separate board certification.
drug_authority.quote: an optometrist authorized to prescribe, administer, or dispense a pharmaceutical agent shall be permitted to prescribe, administer, and dispense for the purpose of diagnosing and treating deficiencies, deformities, diseases, or abnormalities of the human eye and adnexae pharmaceutical agents classified as Schedule III, IV, and V controlled dangerous substances and, regardless of schedule, pharmaceutical agents containing hydrocodone.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed to permit the practice of medicine and surgery as defined in R.S. 45:9-5.1.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: including the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexae

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction

immunization_authority.quote: The practice of optometry shall include the administration of immunizations against coronaviruses and influenza by any route or modality, provided that administration of the immunization is consistent with recommendations issued by the Advisory Committee for Immunization Practices in the federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

value: Schedule I controlled dangerous substances prohibited
Schedule II controlled dangerous substances prohibited (except hydrocodone, which is authorized regardless of schedule)
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: excluding controlled dangerous substances as provided in sections 5 and 6 of P.L.1970, c.226 (C.24:21-5 and C.24:21-6), except as otherwise authorized by section 9 of P.L.1991, c.385

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: those licensees currently certified to use and prescribe pharmaceutical agents for treatment purposes pursuant to P.L.1991, c.385 (C.45:12-9.8 et seq.) shall be immediately credentialed and certified to use and prescribe those pharmaceutical agents authorized by that act for treatment purposes in the practice of optometry but not orally until certified

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: The New Jersey State Board of Optometrists shall establish a comprehensive credentialing and certification process for optometrists to receive certification in the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry

value: certification in the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents
certification to administer immunizations against coronaviruses and influenza
specialty_certification_types.quote: The New Jersey State Board of Optometrists shall establish a comprehensive credentialing and certification process for optometrists to receive certification in the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry

telemedicine_authorized.quote: "Health care provider" means an individual who provides a health care service to a patient, and includes, but is not limited to, a licensed physician, nurse, nurse practitioner, psychologist, psychiatrist, psychoanalyst, clinical social worker, physician assistant, professional counselor, respiratory therapist, speech pathologist, audiologist, optometrist, or any other health care professional acting within the scope of a valid license or certification issued pursuant to Title 45 of the Revised Statutes.

home_visit_permit_required.quote: nothing herein contained shall be construed to require an active licensee to obtain a branch office certificate for the purpose of rendering necessary optometric services to patients confined to their homes, hospitals or other health care facilities licensed by the Department of Health or institutions.

retired_license_status_available.quote: A nonactive registration renewal certificate shall be issued to those not practicing within the State upon payment of a renewal fee

criminal_background_check_required.quote: A professional and occupational licensing board within the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety or the director who regulates the practice of a health care professional, as applicable, shall not issue an initial license or other authorization to practice a health care profession that is regulated by that board
